meta.name: obsidian-markdown
meta.description: Create and edit Obsidian Flavored Markdown with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax. Use when working with .md files in Obsidian, or when the user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, tags, embeds, or Obsidian notes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编辑 Obsidian 专属 Markdown 语法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Obsidian 写笔记，需要处理 wikilink、callout 等特殊语法。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for notes and need to handle wikilinks, callouts, etc.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按 Obsidian 规则创建和修改 .md 笔记,自动使用内部链接([[ ]])、嵌入、提示框、属性和其他 Obsidian 专属语法,并保证格式有效。
howto.when: 当你在 Obsidian 中处理 .md 文件,或提到 wikilinks、callouts、frontmatter 等关键词,或要求写 Obsidian 笔记时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段内容改成 Obsidian 笔记,用内部链接和提示框
给这个笔记加上 YAML 属性:标题、标签和别名
say.note: Claude 会补全或修改 frontmatter

say.text: 把这段列表变成任务清单,并加一个可折叠的 callout
say.note: 生成 - [ ] 任务和 > [!faq]- 折叠块

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to create and edit valid Obsidian Flavored Markdown, using wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax.
howto.when_en: Use when working with .md files in Obsidian, or when the user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, etc.

say_en.text: Turn this content into an Obsidian note with wikilinks and a callout.
say_en.note: Generates Markdown with [[links]] and a callout block.

say_en.text: Add YAML properties: title, tags, and aliases to this note.
say_en.note: Fills in or edits the frontmatter.

say_en.text: Convert this list into tasks with a foldable callout.
say_en.note: Creates - [ ] tasks and a foldable callout.
